user.title: Add a HomeKit accessory
user.description: Each accessory is added to Apple Home on its own, with its own pairing code.

menu_option_descriptions.irrigation: Valves become the zones of one Irrigation System. Each zone has its own run time and closes by itself; turning the system on runs every zone in turn.
menu_option_descriptions.ceiling_fan: A fan and its light as one accessory, instead of two separate tiles.
menu_option_descriptions.buttons: Event entities become HomeKit buttons with single, double and long press, ready for Home automations.
menu_option_descriptions.multi_sensor: Motion, contact, leak, temperature, humidity, light level and battery from one device as one accessory.
menu_option_descriptions.air_quality: All pollutant readings on one Air Quality sensor, rated by the worst one.
menu_option_descriptions.air_purifier: A fan plus optional air quality, humidity, temperature and filter sensors as one Air Purifier.
menu_option_descriptions.power_strip: Several switches as the numbered outlets of one accessory.
menu_option_descriptions.faucet: Valves become the outlets of one Shower or Faucet. Turning it on opens them all.

run_times.title: Run times for {name}
run_times.description: How long each zone runs when started from Apple Home, in seconds (up to 3600; 0 runs until stopped). The valve closes by itself when the time is up. Run times changed in Apple Home are saved here too.

entities.title: Choose entities for {name}
entities.description: Anything found on the device you picked is already filled in. Adjust as needed.

data_description.valves: Each valve becomes a zone (or outlet), named after the valve.
data_description.default_duration: Starting run time for each zone; you can set each zone's own run time on the next step. Up to 3600 seconds; 0 runs until stopped.
data_description.valve_type: How Apple Home shows each outlet.
data_description.one_at_a_time: Starting a zone stops the one that's running. Turning the whole system on always runs zones one after another.
data_description.master: Optional. Turned on while any zone runs and off 5 seconds after the last one stops. It isn't added to Apple Home.
data_description.events: Each event entity becomes one button. Single, double and long presses are recognized from the event types the device reports.
data_description.aqi_sensor: If set, this decides the overall rating instead of the individual pollutants.
data_description.co2_sensor: In ppm. Also shown as a Carbon Dioxide sensor that alerts at 1000 ppm.
data_description.air_quality_sensor: A HomeKit 1-5 value or an AQI value.
data_description.filter_life_sensor: Remaining filter life in %. Apple Home asks for a replacement at 10% or less.
data_description.battery_sensor: Apple Home warns at 20% or less.
data_description.outlets: Switches or input booleans, in outlet order.
data_description.fan: Speed, oscillation and direction are added when the fan supports them.
data_description.light: Brightness is added when the light supports it.

irrigation.title: Irrigation system
irrigation.description:
Valves become the zones of one Irrigation System. Each zone has its own run time and closes by itself; turning the system on runs every zone in turn.

Pick the device it represents to fill in its entities for you, or leave it empty to choose entities yourself.

data_description.name: Shown in Apple Home. Defaults to the device's name.
data_description.device: Optional. Its matching entities are selected on the next step.

data_description.port: Each accessory needs its own port. A free one is suggested.
data_description.pin: 8 digits as 123-45-678. A random code is suggested.

error.invalid_pin: Use the format 123-45-678. HomeKit doesn't allow repeated digits, 123-45-678 or 876-54-321.
error.port_in_use: Another HomeKit accessory or bridge in Home Assistant is set up to use this port.
error.port_busy: Something else on this host is already using this port, such as the old HomeKit Irrigation or Air Purifier integration. Pick another port or stop that service.
error.master_is_zone: The pump or master valve can't also be a zone.
error.no_buttons_selected: Select at least one event entity.
error.no_sensors_selected: Select at least one sensor besides the battery.
error.no_pollutants_selected: Select an air quality index or at least one pollutant sensor.
